msg: SQL built by concatenating the name parameter into the query: SQL injection; use a PreparedStatement with a bind parameter.
A JDBC user lookup does not belong in a class-path utility class (unrelated responsibility, new java.sql dependency).
Fallback still throws NumberFormatException for values with a fraction or exponent ("1.5", "1e3"); intValue() should go through BigDecimal.
longValue() fallback uses new BigInteger(value), which throws for decimal/exponent strings; parse with BigDecimal.
'pinia && activePinia' returns the injected-or-active pinia only when both exist; outside an injection context it returns false instead of falling back to activePinia (should be ||).
subprocess.run with shell=True and the argument interpolated into the command string: command injection; pass an argument list without shell=True.
Request parameter (via configparser round-trip) is reflected into the HTML response without escaping (escape_for_html imported but unused): reflected XSS.
pathname is now const but is reassigned to '/index.html' a few lines below: TypeError at runtime for '/'.
Passwords hashed with unsalted MD5: broken for password storage; use a slow salted KDF (bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2/PBKDF2).
Condition inverted ('!== true'): every non-true value (including ints) now returns IDNA_DEFAULT, so the is_int branch below is unreachable and true no longer maps to the default.
eval() on a string argument: arbitrary code execution; also does not belong in a type-test file.

Counting only functions that carry an explicit ABSTRACT modifier misses interface functions without a body, which are implicitly abstract; valid fun interfaces may be rejected or invalid ones accepted.
Request parameter concatenated into the file path opened with FileOutputStream: path traversal / arbitrary file write.
User-controlled query value used as the format string written to the HTML response (and X-XSS-Protection disabled): reflected XSS.
child_process.exec with the argument interpolated into a shell command: command injection; also an unrelated export in the vitest config.

The pending chunk is now appended after readEscapeCharacter(), which can call fillBuffer() and shift the buffer; buffer[start..start+len] may then point at the wrong characters (previously appended before the escape was read).
Assignment to a field 'initialLength' that is not used anywhere in this change looks like leftover code.
The guard against an invalid $callablePattern was removed: preg_match now emits a warning/returns false and the resolver silently treats 'Class:method' strings as a class name.
Same removed guard: an invalid $callablePattern makes preg_match fail silently and middleware 'class:method' notation is misresolved.
'&&' became '||': every Class is now reported primitive, and a non-Class Type (e.g. ParameterizedType) hits the cast and throws ClassCastException.
Header value concatenated into the SQL passed to batchUpdate: SQL injection; use a parameterized statement.
'index <= endIndex' reads this[endIndex], one past the slice (and past the array when endIndex == size): off-by-one.
Loop runs to i == len(s) and indexes s[i]: index out of range panic for every input; must be i < len(s).
'||' became '&&': a backwards seek (currentOffset > fileOffset) no longer reopens the stream unless also at EOF, so reads return data from the wrong offset.

Precision derived from toString().split('.') breaks for values printed in exponent form (1.0E10, 1.0E-5) and NaN/Infinity, producing wrong literals; also %L now reformats every Number (grouping '_'), changing output for BigDecimal/Long callers.
'||' became '&&' contrary to the comment ('or'): the activeHelp delimiter is no longer added when file completion follows without other completions.
'split' removed from the local list but '_init_completion -s' still assigns it, so it leaks into the user's shell as a global; same for completions_func if it is still assigned later.
unserialize() on a cookie value: PHP object injection; use json_decode or unserialize with allowed_classes => false (and sign the cookie).
After pop(0), bar is the form parameter; it is joined into the path opened for writing: path traversal / arbitrary file write.
Condition inverted ('is not None'): any configured max age now returns None, and a None config falls through to return None anyway; the timedelta branch is dead.
pickle.loads on caller-supplied data allows arbitrary code execution; use JSON or a signed, restricted format.
The catch branch exists for browsers where 'new MouseEvent' throws, but the fallback now uses the same constructor, so it throws again; also screenX/screenY changed from 0 to 80/20.
Origin check inverted: same-origin links now go through the CORS path while cross-origin links are downloaded directly.
Condition inverted ('offset == 0'): a +00:00 suffix is written for UTC and no offset at all for non-UTC zones, producing wrong timestamps.
Cookie value is joined into the path passed to codecs.open: path traversal / arbitrary file read.
A method with a body in an interface must be 'default' or 'static': this does not compile; and the method is unrelated to date printing.
Runtime.exec with the argument concatenated into the command string: command/argument injection; pass an argument array or use ProcessBuilder with validated args.
Removing the public (deprecated) checkNotNull is a binary-incompatible change; the removed comment says external projects may call it, so this needs a major-version note or a longer deprecation.

Calls the private Werkzeug method _update_cookies_from_response with a 3-argument signature (Werkzeug 3.x); with older Werkzeug this raises TypeError, so the minimum Werkzeug version must be bumped (and private API use is fragile).
self._cookies only exists on newer Werkzeug test clients; AttributeError on older versions now that the hasattr fallback is gone.
'<= 0' rejects read(0), which is a valid PSR-7 call, and the message still says 'negative': off-by-one in the guard.
'and' became 'or': with no positional args, args[0] is evaluated and raises IndexError; with any args the isinstance check is skipped and every first arg is treated as a builder/environ.
Condition inverted: operators are emitted by name and the else branch dereferences operator when it is null (operator.operator).
Runtime.exec with the argument interpolated into a single command string: argument injection; use ProcessBuilder with a validated argument list. Also unrelated to the metadata API.
'<= 500' treats HTTP 500 as a 4xx and runs the digest-auth retry path on server errors: off-by-one in the range.
exec.Command("sh", "-c", "tool "+arg): shell command injection; call exec.Command("tool", arg) directly.
urlparse().hostname is lower-cased and None for host-less URLs: case-sensitive .netrc machine names stop matching, and authenticators(None) can raise.

socket.outputStream is now fetched eagerly when the sink is constructed; getOutputStream() throws if the socket is not yet connected, already closed or output-shutdown, so creating the sink can fail where it used to be lazy.
Same eager socket.inputStream in SocketSource: throws at construction for unconnected/closed sockets.
Condition inverted: with a validator set, validation is skipped; with Validator == nil it calls ValidateStruct on a nil interface and panics.
'&&' became '||': on PHP 7 curl_share_close is called even when the handle is no longer a resource (TypeError/warning), and on PHP 8 any resource handle is closed by a PHP-7-only helper.
The resolve for a selected file was removed: after choosing a file the promise never settles, so file import hangs.
With explain-template-loading enabled, a template that was found (trv) is no longer returned: every lookup raises TemplateNotFound.
$_GET['name'] concatenated into the SQL string: SQL injection; use a prepared statement. Also a DB lookup does not belong in routing middleware.
'i <= length()' calls charAt(length()) for an all-digit version string (e.g. "17"): StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Null check removed: switch on a null String throws NullPointerException, contradicting the documented 'null if unknown' contract.
Treating null as EPOCH makes toMillisSince(null) silently return ~56 years of milliseconds instead of failing fast; surprising semantics for a public API.
Javadoc still says '@param instant ... not null' while the method now accepts null; contract is contradictory.
c.Keys is read and iterated without holding c.mu, while Set/Get lock it; Copy() racing with a concurrent Set can panic with concurrent map read and write.
Error message interpolates $this (the file system) instead of $path.
Files.list entries already include the directory (dir/x); 'dir / entry.toString()' duplicates it for relative dirs (dir/dir/x) and yields absolute paths for absolute ones; use entry.fileName.
Early return for types without type arguments removed: non-generic KClasses now become a ParameterizedTypeName with no arguments, which is invalid (rejected or rendered as Foo<>).
Invalid XML now returns false instead of null; withParsedBody(false) violates PSR-7 (null|array|object) and throws InvalidArgumentException instead of treating the body as unparsed.
itsdangerous signs with the LAST key in the list; appending fallbacks after secret_key means new sessions are signed with an old fallback key, defeating key rotation. The current key must be last.
When initialState exists but has no entry for this key (e.g. state added after the payload was produced), the ref is overwritten with undefined; guard with 'key in initialState'.
Error check removed: err is now unused (compile error 'declared and not used'), and if it compiled, a failed os.Create would write to a nil *os.File and lose the real error.
SQL built by concatenating name: SQL injection; use db.Query("... WHERE name = ?", name).
An invalid 'headers' option is a caller argument error, but it is reported as RequestException (a transfer/network exception callers catch for retries); throw InvalidArgumentException instead.
